name: sole-archive
description: Academic digital archive and research discovery platform for ConSOLE proceedings

scripts.prebuild: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('src/content/papers.json','public/papers.json')" && python scripts/build_related_slugs.py && python scripts/venues_count.py && python scripts/affiliation_checker.py && node scripts/generate_og_images.mjs && node scripts/generate_og_volume_images.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx gh-pages -d dist -b gh-pages
